body: The black umbrella has a treated-seed stain on it. The camera carries a closure mark. One rope knot holds the two together.
title: Black umbrella and camera

body: A clear ring has dried across the notebook's crop-row drawing. The bottle cap is clean. The page is stained only where the drawn rows meet.
title: Notebook and water bottle

body:
“Track access ends at the barrier. Keep the west lane clear for the last vehicle.” The receiving line is blank; on the back, someone asks for a green scarf to be saved.

The person who handed this to me asked me to keep the date. I did, though the next version left that day out entirely.

The next morning I looked for a second copy and found only the envelope. I left this one unfolded for whoever came after us.
title: Dispatch slip

body:
The note lists three crop rows and a water check across both sides. A phone number is written below the last line.

The paper felt damp when I picked it up from the desk. The mark on my thumb did not come off when I washed my hands.

I kept it because the number might still work. The stain spread to my other fingers by morning.
title: Notepad page
